messages.subject: Executive Value Creation Brief | QatarEnergy LNG | SHES & Sustainability
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Rizzi,

I am sharing a strategic value creation brief prepared for QatarEnergy LNG, focused on SHES performance, North Field expansion, contractor governance, sustainability assurance and operational stakeholder alignment. My current work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships and cross-functional execution in a multinational mining environment.

The attached brief outlines areas where this experience could support large-project sustainability and stakeholder governance. I would welcome a short discussion regarding senior leadership or strategic mandates where my background would add value.

Regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for QatarEnergy LNG
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Head of SHES - North Field Production Sustainability (NFPS) COMP3 Project
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ragunauth Ramsaroop offers a leadership profile aligned with QatarEnergy LNG's agenda across SHES performance, North Field expansion, contractor governance, sustainability assurance and operational stakeholder alignment. His experience combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory in a multinational mining environment. He works across operations, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security and technical teams, translating external obligations into coordinated execution. For QatarEnergy LNG, his strongest contribution would sit where major-project sustainability, contractor performance, regulatory expectations and stakeholder commitments require consistent governance, traceable evidence and executive accountability across delivery teams.
strategic_brief.company_context: QatarEnergy LNG is operating within the North Field expansion and a wider QatarEnergy strategy that combines LNG growth with carbon capture, operational responsibility and sustainability commitments. These capital-intensive programmes involve complex contractor ecosystems, technical interfaces, environmental controls and public-sector expectations. SHES leadership therefore depends on more than standards and reporting: performance must be embedded in contractor governance, issue escalation, evidence ownership and executive decision-making across project phases. A leader experienced in resource-sector ESG, regulatory coordination and cross-functional execution can help strengthen assurance, connect external commitments to operating owners and improve visibility of sustainability risks and actions across large project environments.

opportunities.title: Contractor SHES governance
opportunities.rationale: Large project ecosystems rely on contractors with different systems, maturity levels and responsibilities. Common governance and evidence requirements improve consistency, visibility and accountability across SHES performance.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can support contractor assurance through commitment registers, evidence standards, review gates and executive issue tracking linking procurement, technical, SHES and management teams.

opportunities.title: Sustainability evidence assurance
opportunities.rationale: Project sustainability performance gains credibility when source data, methodologies, ownership and review processes are defined before reporting and remain traceable through management decisions and corrective actions.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can build evidence registers and accountability matrices connecting sustainability commitments to project owners, source records, assurance steps and executive reporting routines.

opportunities.title: Regulatory stakeholder alignment
opportunities.rationale: Major energy projects face environmental, safety, permitting and community expectations across authorities and stakeholders. Structured engagement helps prevent inconsistent commitments and supports faster resolution of emerging issues.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can establish stakeholder maps, regulatory issue registers and escalation pathways that connect external expectations with internal project actions, owners and documented follow-through.

days_0_30: Map SHES commitments, contractor interfaces, regulatory stakeholders and evidence owners.
days_31_60: Create assurance, stakeholder and executive issue registers for priority workstreams.
days_61_90: Launch cross-functional governance linking SHES, projects, procurement and external interfaces.
days_91_180: Embed assurance metrics, lessons learned and management reporting across selected project areas.

potential_impact: Stronger contractor accountability for SHES commitments.
More traceable sustainability and environmental evidence.
Improved coordination across regulators, project teams and contractors.
background_relevance: ESG and social-performance leadership in a large mining operation.
Government and regulatory relations across multiple public authorities.
Cross-functional coordination with technical, operations, procurement, security and executive teams.
